Bridge loses $5M in a single transaction

The brief draws on 4 sources from 4 publishers.

- A bridge on Ethereum lost $5M in a single transaction after an operator key was compromised [1].
- The team paused withdrawals within an hour and confirmed the loss in a status update [2].
- A post mortem published the next day attributes the drain to a leaked deployer key [3].
